name: Fey Elf
body:
The elves that remained in the Fey Realms survived by adapting to the raw, environmental magic found therein. By the time each fey elf reaches adulthood, they choose one environmental theme to channel through themselves: spring, summer, autumn, or winter.

Spring elves have fair skin, flaxen hair, and sparkling green eyes. They dress from head to toe in green and yellow clothing that mimics the designs of petals and leaves.

Summer elves have dark skin and black hair, and prefer bright white and pastel clothing, with fruit and vine motifs. Autumn elves have bronzed skin and copper-red hair, and wear clothing with multihued earth-tones.

The cornucopia is their unifying crest.

Finally, the winter elves have pale skin and white or silver hair. They dress in gowns of white, silver, and gold, with wreaths of red and green upon their brows.

Core Traits
Ability Scores You gain +2 Cha, –2 Con, and +2 to one other ability score depending on your season, as follows: spring +2 Dex, summer +2 Str, autumn +2 Wis, or winter +2 Int. This trait alters ability scores.
Gifts of the Fey Traits You gain certain special abilities based upon your seasonal theme. This trait replaces elven magic and weapon familiarity.
Spring Elf: You gain electricity resistance 5 and a +2 species bonus to Handle Animal checks. Once per day, you can use animal aspect as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level.
Summer Elf: You gain fire resistance 5 and a +2 species bonus to Bluff checks. Once per day, you can use vine strike as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability score.
Autumn Elf: You gain a +2 species bonus against effects that cause the fatigued or exhausted condition. You also gain a +2 species bonus to Diplomacy checks. Once per day, you can use calm emotions as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability score.
Winter Elf: You gain cold resistance 5 and a +2 species bonus to Intimidate checks. Once per day, you can use haunting mists as a spell-like ability, using your character level as the caster level and Charisma as your casting ability score.
